up: Retrieve the distinct target names (pref_name) for assays conducted in the organism 'Escherichia coli'. Join the assays table with the target_dictionary on tid. Filter where assay_organism equals 'Escherichia coli'. Return only the distinct pref_name values.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT td.pref_name FROM assays a JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid WHERE a.assay_organism = 'Escherichia coli'
